title: Appraisal Order Complexity Add-On Amount Owed
content:
# Appraisal Order complexity add-on — amount owed

**1. When it is owed.** The complexity add-on is charged once, on the order's gross-living-area surcharge line, on an order whose completed report states a gross living area per dwelling unit above the report type's gross-living-area surcharge threshold, and nothing is owed when that area is at or below the threshold.

**2. Area per dwelling unit.** The gross living area per dwelling unit is the gross living area the report states divided by the number of units on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports.

**3. Orders never charged.** An order placed as an HPML flip second appraisal is never charged the complexity add-on.

**4. Amount.** The standard complexity add-on is the report type's gross-living-area surcharge, charged at its own amount with nothing added to it.

**5. Collected only once.** Any amount already standing on the order's gross-living-area surcharge line — the charges on that line less any refunds of that line — is taken off the complexity add-on, the result never going below zero, so the add-on is collected only once.

**6. Precision.** The figure owed is kept to the cent.

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs: report type with a 4000 square-foot threshold and a 150.00 dollar gross-living-area surcharge)

| Report states | Units on the loan file | Area per unit | Already standing on the line | Owed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4600 sq ft | 1 | 4600 | 0.00 | 150.00 |
| 4000 sq ft | 1 | 4000 | 0.00 | 0.00 — at the threshold, not above it |
| 7000 sq ft | 2 | 3500 | 0.00 | 0.00 — per-unit area below the threshold |
| 4600 sq ft | 1 | 4600 | 150.00 | 0.00 — 150.00 less 150.00 |
| 4600 sq ft | 1 | 4600 | 100.00 | 50.00 — 150.00 less 100.00 |

An order placed as an HPML flip second appraisal owes 0.00 in every row above.
